svg.aria-label: flow-1 reads every production trace as it lands. Six traces from support, coding, browser and research agents are read one after another. Four show no issue; two are flagged: a coding agent whose report contradicts its test output, and a support agent that promised a refund without approval. The two signal events go to Slack as an alert.
